summary_zh:
這裡是「地熱谷」與「米湖」這座山必經的道路，當你翻過這麼山，靠近米湖這邊，有一個觀景台，別開太快，這裡可以眺望米湖區風。

如果你是從米湖出發，那這觀景台在你右手邊．如果是從地熱谷往米湖過來，他就在對向。
summary_en: This viewpoint is on the road between the Geothermal Valley and Mývatn, and after crossing the mountain you’ll find it on the right side of the lake when coming from Mývatn, or opposite when coming from the Geothermal Valley. It offers a clear view of the Mývatn area; drive carefully and take your time to enjoy the scenery. Parking is free on site. No restroom facilities are available. A 30‑minute stop is recommended.
